name: 95819 · Sacramento, CA
findings: ZIP 95819 (Sacramento) has 123 nonprofit organizations. 63 of them (51%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 55 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (23% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 95819 (Sacramento) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 95819 (Sacramento) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.6 times the typical level).
